title: ServiceNow HRSD pricing - $24-$108 per employee/year, priced on full headcount
clean_text: ServiceNow HR Service Delivery is priced per employee across the full company headcount (not per HR user), running roughly $24-$108 per employee per year in 2026 depending on tier (a lower tier for core case/knowledge management, a higher tier adding employee journeys and broader integration), total headcount, and the rest of a customer's ServiceNow estate. There is no single list price; real customers commonly negotiate 25-40% discounts off list for HRSD specifically. Add-ons such as AI agents, workflow automation, performance analytics, and integration hub are sold separately and can significantly increase total cost.
